name: South Bridge Pivot
description: A controlled replay variant of Scenario 1. The learner investigates an external scan, suspicious authentication, encrypted beacon-like traffic, internal discovery, and outbound data transfer while preserving the same foundational learning objectives as Scenario 1A.

global_design_notes.network_only_boundary: This variant uses firewall logs, IDS alerts, authentication summaries, DNS logs, proxy logs, network flow summaries, SMB/data-access summaries, DLP summaries, and SOC-facing endpoint status summaries only.
global_design_notes.variant_rule: Preserves Scenario 1A learning objectives while changing indicators, affected asset, log wording, evidence placement, and decoys to reduce memorization.
global_design_notes.ai_support_note: AI may explain backend-approved facts but cannot decide correctness, score, pass/fail, progression, or remedy selection.

stages.name: Reconnaissance - Exposed Remote Service
stages.learning_objective: Validate external reconnaissance behavior, confirm the exposed perimeter service, and inspect the communication path before blocking the source.
